name: restore_session
description:
Restores full agent session context in one call — loads checkpoint, plan, milestones, recent learnings, and recent log entries.
Use when: starting a new session, switching clients, or waking up an agent after a break. Call this first before any work.
Scope: local filesystem. No network access.
Not for: restoring only a checkpoint (use memory_restore), reading a single fact (use memory_read).

checkpoint.description: Checkpoint name to restore. Defaults to 'latest'.

include.description: Which sections to include. Omit to include all.
